description:
Job Description 
 Relevant Experience (Yrs) :  Total 8+ Years of experience. 
 Hands on working experience in J2EE technology.
 Necessary Skills : 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer science or equivalent with minimum 5 years of experience in JDK 1.8 , Springs 3.x, Hibernate 4.0, JPA 2.0 

 Working knowledge of JMS and JBoss Messaging, Active MQ.
 Deep expertise in Object Oriented analysis and design, UML modeling, Classic design patterns and J2EE patterns.
 Experience with Eclipse, XML, SOAP/REST Web Services, CFX and JBossWS is essential.
 Diverse and deep experience utilizing Java tools in business, Web, and client-server environments.
 Strong Experience working on large volume databases, Oracle 11g is required, , PLSQL, Stored Procedure.
 Strong experience optimizing service performance for large volumes of data.
 Well proven skills in data analysis and ability to relate data to business processes.
 Experience working in complex projects with multi-tier architecture.
 Demonstrated ability to influence critical business outcomes in a matrix based, global environment
 Desired Skills: 
 Ability to manage change effectively
 Strong networking skills and ability to work across multiple organizations to meet the delivery timelines.
 Roles & Responsibilities:   
 Participate in requirement gathering , analysis and brainstorming sessions with business for enhancements and capital projects
 Design , development , unit testing , system integration testing , assist in UAT and production development.
 Develop or modify moderately complex information systems documentation and conveys this information to technical team for translation into programming languages or implements into COTS technologies.
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6+ Months
